item.title: AAA advises drivers to watch for deer on drive home as the sun sets earlier
item.description:
The sun sets earlier in the evening after the clocks were set back Sunday for Daylight Saving Time, which means some people will be driving home in the dark while deer are at peak activity for the day.

AAA is advising drivers to keep an eye out for deer and warn them that swerving to avoid one can be deadly.

“Every instinct tells you to swerve, but following that instinct is often what gets people hurt,” AAA spokesperson Carly McKinnis wrote in a press release.
